title: export_token_transfer parses token amounts with ParseFloat into a float64 and scales them by 0.0000001, so the amount column is inexact
severity_basis: Lossy export of a derived column: TokenTransferOutput.Amount is a float64, so an amount above 2^53 raw units loses digits and the 1e-7 scaling is inexact even for small values; the exact value stays in amount_raw. No halt. The issue is already open upstream.

entries.expected: token amounts exported at full width (a decimal string, NUMERIC or big integer), or with their precision stated
entries.observed: XDR402 (warning) five times in transformEvents, internal/transform/token_transfer.go:57, :62, :67, :72 and :77 (transfer, mint, burn, clawback, fee): amountFloat, _ = strconv.ParseFloat(amount, 64) followed by amountFloat = amountFloat * 0.0000001, stored in TokenTransferOutput.Amount (make lint-stellar-etl). The corpus entry is the one the linter maps XDR402 to.
The corpus entry holds a payment of 2^53 + 1 stroops, the smallest amount a float64 cannot hold; no run of it through export_token_transfer is recorded, so this record rests on the linter report.

evidence.pre_fix: make lint-stellar-etl (xdrlint built with the Go toolchain stellar-etl requires, shipped default profile) at v2.8.35 (7e3fc9af): XDR402, severity warning, at the five ParseFloat calls in transformEvents, suppressed with this record as its finding.
evidence.expected_basis: Amounts are int64 in classic operations and i128 in contract events (CAP-46, CAP-67); a float64 holds every integer only up to 2^53, and 0.0000001 has no exact binary representation (lint/docs/XDR402.md).

reproduction.by: kit maintainer (linter re-run and source reading at the pinned commit)
reproduction.method: make lint-stellar-etl OFFLINE=1 at the pinned commit: the five reports again at the recorded lines; transformEvents read again at 7e3fc9af.

evidence_added.reason: The issue, opened by a stellar-etl maintainer, already records that amounts are stored as lossy float64 and that the token transfer amount's 1e-7 scaling is inexact; the linter reports point at the same five lines.

history.note: From the stellar-etl linter run at the pinned commit (XDR402 at token_transfer.go:57, :62, :67, :72, :77); listed as pending finding review.
Sites verified at 7e3fc9af; the open upstream item already records this defect. Suppressed at the pinned commit with this record as its finding; the five pending entries removed.
